'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Schwarz DS Ralltiir Operations (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Schwarz]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (V)|V10-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Karakagin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
